note: Johannesberg Golf & CC, niohalsbanan -- a full-length Donald Steel nine WEST and NORTH-WEST of the manor, the club being 27 holes in total. Environment shared verbatim with the eighteen (johannesbergbuild/course-model.json); the eighteen is carried here as scenery. Hole routing from published GPS routes that form a closed nine-hole loop; hole lengths exact from the club card; greens, fairways and tee pads synthesised and marked prov:"synth".
